descriptions.w3d_projectile_tick_800d5c68: Advances projectile motion and delayed activation, then releases completed effects and returns a 20-tick interval.
descriptions.w3d_projectile_update_bounds_800d60ac: Raises the projectile position by a fixed radius and updates the actor handle bounds.
descriptions.w3d_projectile_place_ground_800d5ff0: Traces toward the ground, copies the hit position and owner data, and updates projectile bounds.
descriptions.w3d_projectile_effect_800d673c: Spawns the petrol-bomb effect once at the projectile position.
descriptions.w3d_projectile_post_owner_slot_800d6788: Posts the projectile owner and slot pair and reports whether the shared event state is clear.
